tables.customquery:
SELECT
		[CheckComparison].[ParentId] AS [ParentId],
		[CheckComparison].[ParentName] AS [ParentName],
		[CheckComparison].[TotalTarget] AS [TotalTarget],
		[CheckComparison].[TotalActual] AS [TotalActual],
		[CheckComparison].[Percentage] AS [Percentage]
FROM [dbo].[CheckComparison] AS [CheckComparison]
